packageRules.description: Each Hermes release gets its own PR at once, so the Hermes compatibility check runs on it before the Flux upgrade PR is merged. Merge it by hand: see hub/docs/hermes-upgrade.md.

Each Hermes release gets its own PR at once for hermes/Dockerfile. CI applies the patches to it and runs their tests and the hub and device checks; a green PR merges and the Hermes release workflow publishes v<release>-p1. Rolling it out stays a manual Flux merge.
